subject: Add bands and families outside fan plot

messages.author: b728f3845ed498d7
messages.subject: Add bands and families outside fan plot
parts:
Hi all,

A very nice phylogeny was recently published in this paper: http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/nph.14045/full.  It's very nice!  I'm especially interested in the band outside the circular diagram that indicates family, and the annotation of family as well.  I'm wondering - does ggtree have any facilities for bands and textual annotations such as these?

thanks,
alex

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Add bands and families outside fan plot
